questbook.skofcraft.blahaj.title: Blåhaj
questbook.skofcraft.blahaj.p1: A big soft shark. Craft it from blue, light blue and white wool and a black dye.
questbook.skofcraft.blahaj.p2: Place it anywhere as decoration, or right-click it, placed or in hand, to hug it. A hug gives a few seconds of Regeneration and lowers your phone addiction by 5%, at most once every 3 seconds.
tooltip.skofcraft.f14: Right-click a block to place it, then right-click it to board.
message.skofcraft.f14_controls: W/S throttle | Look to steer | A/D rudder | Space afterburner | Attack: cannon | Use: missile
questbook.skofcraft.f14.title: F-14 Tomcat
questbook.skofcraft.f14.p1: A carrier fighter with swing wings. Build it on the Aircraft Workbench from two Jet Engines, two Weapon Systems, Avionics, Aircraft Plates, Gears, glass and an iron block, and fuel it before take-off (see Aircraft Workshop).
questbook.skofcraft.f14.p2: Place it on flat ground and right-click to board. Hold W to raise the throttle and S to lower it, look where you want to go, and nudge the rudder with A and D. It only leaves the ground above take-off speed, and below stall speed the nose drops, so keep it fast. Hold Space at full throttle for the afterburner.
questbook.skofcraft.f14.p3: Attack fires the Vulcan cannon. Use fires a Sidewinder that locks onto the nearest creature in front of you and steers toward it. Hitting the ground or a wall at speed destroys the jet, so land gently with the nose level. A second player can ride in the back seat.
tooltip.skofcraft.aircraft_carrier: Use on open water to launch. Needs room: 17 wide, 72 long.
message.skofcraft.carrier_no_room: Not enough open water here: the carrier needs a clear area 17 by 72 blocks, 4 deep.
message.skofcraft.carrier_deployed: Carrier launched! Climb to the bridge and use the helm to get underway.
message.skofcraft.carrier_not_a_ship: This helm is not on a carrier's bridge.
message.skofcraft.carrier_no_reactor: Reactor offline: the carrier needs its nuclear reactor to sail.
message.skofcraft.carrier_controls: W/S: throttle   A/D: rudder   Shift: all stop and drop anchor
message.skofcraft.carrier_underway: The ship is underway. Wait for the captain to drop anchor.
advancements.skofcraft.anchors_aweigh.de: Take the helm of a carrier and get underway.

advancements.skofcraft.cat_shot.descript: Get launched off a steam catapult in an F-14.
advancements.skofcraft.trap.title: Trap

advancements.skofcraft.meltdown.title: Not Great, Not Terrible
questbook.skofcraft.carrier.title: Aircraft Carrier
questbook.skofcraft.carrier.p1: The Nuclear Aircraft Carrier is the biggest thing you can build. It starts with a Naval Nuclear Reactor, assembled on the Aircraft Workbench. A reactor on its own also pushes 2000 FE per tick into every machine touching it. Handle with care: any explosion that reaches a reactor, even a creeper, makes it melt down: a giant blast, then rings of explosions racing out across the deck and through the hull, setting off every other reactor they reach.
questbook.skofcraft.carrier.p2: The bridge needs a Carrier Helm, and the flight deck comes with Steam Catapults and Arresting Wires. You can craft extra ones to build your own deck.
questbook.skofcraft.carrier.p3: Put it all together on the Aircraft Workbench. Use the carrier on open water: it is built in front of you with the bow pointing where you look, so you need a clear area 17 blocks wide, 72 long and 4 deep.
questbook.skofcraft.carrier.p4: While anchored the carrier is made of normal blocks: walk around, build on it, park your jets. Climb the ladder in the island to the bridge and use the helm. The whole ship lifts out of the water and sails with everyone aboard. W and S set the throttle, A and D turn the rudder. Watch out for shallow water, or you will run aground.
questbook.skofcraft.carrier.rooms: Below decks, the ladder at the stern leads down through the hangar to a passageway along the port side. From bow to stern it runs past the chain locker, crew berthing with bunk beds, the mess with a stocked galley, the reactor room, a workshop with an Aircraft Workbench and spare parts, the sick bay and the captain's cabin. The hangar has a refuelling station with jet fuel. Everything you leave aboard sails with the ship.
questbook.skofcraft.carrier.p5: Press Shift at the helm to drop anchor. The ship stops, squares up and turns back into blocks. To launch an F-14, roll onto a catapult and go to full throttle. To land, touch down on the arresting wires at the stern and the hook will stop you. Keep explosions away from the reactor.
tooltip.skofcraft.damage_control_kit: Use on an anchored carrier's helm to repair the ship and pump out flooding.
message.skofcraft.carrier_repaired: Damage control: %s blocks rebuilt, %s flooded spaces pumped dry. The ship is shipshape!
message.skofcraft.carrier_repair_partial: Damage control: %s blocks rebuilt, %s pumped dry, %s still missing. Use another kit.
message.skofcraft.carrier_repair_none: Nothing to repair: the ship is in good shape.
questbook.skofcraft.carrier.repair: Took a beating? Craft a Damage Control Kit and use it on the helm while anchored. It rebuilds the hull, decks, walls, doors, ladders, lights and deck gear exactly as they were, and pumps out every flooded compartment. Each block rebuilt costs one point of durability. It never replaces anything you built, and it does not recreate reactors, the helm, containers or workstations: craft those again yourself.
advancements.skofcraft.radar_contact.des: Spot an aircraft on a radar scope
questbook.skofcraft.carrier.radar: Know who is coming. The Radar shows everything around it on a sweeping scope: aircraft in red, ships in blue, players in cyan, hostile mobs in orange, wildlife in green. Hover a blip for its distance, bearing and altitude. Unpowered it sees 64 blocks; feed it 40 FE/t (a reactor next to it will do) and it sees 256. It also outputs a redstone signal that gets stronger as the nearest contact in its filter closes in: wire it to a door, a bell or a TNT trap. Every new carrier ships with one on the bridge, next to the helm.
message.skofcraft.turret_mode.all: engaging all threats (players and aircraft too, except yours and your team's)
questbook.skofcraft.carrier.defense: Every new carrier is armed: two CIWS gatling cannons and two SAM launchers on the deck corners, and another CIWS on the island roof. They work on their own. The CIWS shreds anything it may engage within 40 blocks; the SAM launcher fires homing missiles at aircraft and flying mobs up to 96 blocks out. Both lead moving targets and need a clear line of fire. By default they only engage hostile mobs. Right-click one with an empty hand to switch it to all threats: it then also engages players and manned aircraft, except its owner and the owner's team. A turret belongs to whoever placed it, or for a carrier's own guns, whoever first switches them. Both can be crafted and placed anywhere.

satellite.skofcraft.strike.tooltip: In orbit: drops a tungsten rod wherever you aim an Orbital Strike Designator. Recharges in 60 s.

message.skofcraft.strike_no_satellite: No strike satellite in orbit: launch one first.
message.skofcraft.strike_recharging: Strike satellites lining up: ready in %s s.
message.skofcraft.strike_no_target: No target: aim at a block within range.
message.skofcraft.strike_inbound: Strike inbound on target %s m away: impact in %s s!
message.skofcraft.satellite_in_orbit: %s reached orbit. Satellites overhead: %s recon, %s strike.
message.skofcraft.launch_pad_occupied: A satellite is already loaded. Sneak-right-click with an empty hand to take it out.
message.skofcraft.launch_pad_ready: Payload: %s, fuel %s/%s. Ready: right-click with an empty hand or send a redstone pulse to launch.
message.skofcraft.orbit_status: In orbit over this dimension: %s recon, %s strike satellites.
advancements.skofcraft.orbital_strike.de: Call down a tungsten rod from orbit.
questbook.skofcraft.space.title: Space Program
questbook.skofcraft.space.p1: Build a Launch Pad and put it under open sky. Right-click it with a satellite to load it (a rocket appears on the pad), then with 8 Jet Fuel Canisters. Right-click with an empty hand or send a redstone pulse: after a five-second countdown the rocket lifts off and, high above the build limit, puts its satellite in orbit over that dimension. Stand clear at ignition: the exhaust burns. Sneak-right-click with an empty hand to unload the satellite and see what is in orbit.
questbook.skofcraft.space.p2: A Recon Satellite extends the range of every powered radar in its dimension by 256 blocks. Two of them take a radar to 768.
questbook.skofcraft.space.p3: A Strike Satellite belongs to whoever loaded it, and their team. Aim an Orbital Strike Designator at a block up to 512 blocks away and right-click: a red beam marks the target for three seconds, then a tungsten rod falls from orbit and hits it harder than a stack of TNT. Each strike satellite needs a minute to line up again; more satellites, more strikes. Mind the reactors.
phone.skofcraft.map.locked_hint: Live satellite imagery needs a Recon Satellite in orbit over this dimension. Build a Launch Pad and send one up.
phone.skofcraft.map.satellites: Satellites: %s recon, %s strike. Drag to pan.
message.skofcraft.strike_unloaded: No imagery of that area: strike cancelled.
message.skofcraft.strike_inbound_map: Strike inbound on X %s Z %s: impact in %s s!
questbook.skofcraft.space.p4: With a Recon Satellite overhead, the Sat Map app on your phone shows live imagery around you, with players and aircraft on it. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom. If you also have strike satellites, arm STRIKE and tap anywhere on the map to call a rod down there.
tooltip.skofcraft.giga_icbm: Leaves a crater 140 blocks across and burns everything for 170 blocks around.
tooltip.skofcraft.giga_icbm.how: Mark a target first (sneak-use an Orbital Strike Designator, or right-click the Sat Map), then load it onto a Launch Pad with 32 Jet Fuel Canisters.
tooltip.skofcraft.doomsday_missile: Creative only. Five Giga ICBMs in one: a crater about 680 blocks across and destruction for 900 blocks around. Takes a minute or two to finish spreading.
tooltip.skofcraft.orbital_designator.icb: Sneak-right-click: mark the Giga ICBM target, up to 1024 blocks away.
message.skofcraft.icbm_marked: Giga ICBM target marked at X %s Z %s.
message.skofcraft.icbm_no_target: %s (no target: mark one, then right-click the pad with the designator)
message.skofcraft.icbm_launched: WARNING: a Giga ICBM has launched from X %s Z %s!
message.skofcraft.icbm_midcourse: Giga ICBM in midcourse flight: impact on X %s Z %s in about %s s.
message.skofcraft.icbm_incoming_sub: Impact at X %s Z %s, %s m from you, in about %s s. RUN.
advancements.skofcraft.giga_icbm.title: Mutually Assured Destruction
questbook.skofcraft.space.p5: The Giga ICBM is the end of the tech tree. Its warhead needs a dragon head, a nether star, end crystals, two netherite blocks and a whole nuclear reactor. Mark a target with the designator (sneak-right-click) or by right-clicking on the Sat Map, load the missile onto a Launch Pad and pump in 32 Jet Fuel Canisters. Ten seconds of sirens, then it leaves the world and comes back down on the target: a blinding white flash, a crater 140 blocks wide lined with obsidian and lava, a ridge of rubble, scorched land and dead forest for 170 blocks beyond, and a purple mushroom cloud you can see from anywhere.
tooltip.skofcraft.apache: Right-click a block to place it, then right-click it to board.
message.skofcraft.apache_controls: Look to turn | W/S/A/D move | Space up | C down | Attack: gun | Use: rockets
questbook.skofcraft.apache.title: Apache
questbook.skofcraft.apache.p1: For the day the Tobacconist's competitors get ideas. Build the Apache Attack Helicopter on the Aircraft Workbench from Rotor Blades, a Jet Engine, two Weapon Systems, Avionics, Aircraft Plates, Gears, glass and an iron block, and fuel it before flying (see Aircraft Workshop).
questbook.skofcraft.apache.p2: Place it on the ground and right-click to board; Shift gets you out. The pilot steers by looking around, W and S fly forward and back, A and D strafe, Space climbs and C descends. Without input it hovers.
questbook.skofcraft.apache.p3: Attack fires the chain gun and Use fires rockets from the wing pods, both aimed at your crosshair. Rockets explode on impact, so keep your distance. A second player can ride in the front seat. Hit it with bare hands to pick it up.
message.skofcraft.aircraft_out_of_fuel: Out of fuel! The engines are dead.
questbook.skofcraft.aircraft.title: Aircraft Workshop
questbook.skofcraft.aircraft.p1: Aircraft are not built on a crafting table. Craft an Aircraft Workbench: it has a 5 by 4 grid (20 slots) for engines, weapons, the Apache and the F-14. Like a crafting table it keeps nothing, so items left in the grid come back to you when you close it.
questbook.skofcraft.aircraft.p2: The basic parts are made on a normal crafting table: Gears, Aircraft Plates from iron and copper, Turbine Blades, Rotor Blades and Avionics (quartz, redstone, a comparator, an observer and gold).
questbook.skofcraft.aircraft.p3: The Jet Engine and the Weapon System are assembled on the Aircraft Workbench. A jet engine needs turbine blades, gears, a blaze rod, fire charges and a diamond.
questbook.skofcraft.aircraft.p4: Aircraft run on fuel. Craft Empty Fuel Canisters, then fill one with a Lava Bucket, Blaze Powder and Coal (the bucket stays in the grid). Right-click an aircraft with a Jet Fuel Canister to refuel it: each canister gives 4 minutes of engine time and gives the empty canister back. The engines burn fuel as long as someone is at the controls. Fuel stays in the tank when you pick the aircraft up.
questbook.skofcraft.aircraft.p5: With an empty tank the F-14 loses thrust and glides down, and the Apache's rotor spins down so it sinks. A destroyed aircraft throws salvage around after the explosion: iron nuggets, gears and plates, and with luck blades, avionics or even a whole jet engine.
questbook.skofcraft.phone.p4: Careful: screen time builds a phone addiction. The home screen shows it under Digital Wellbeing, apps get red notification badges, and above 60% Scrollr scrolls by itself. Stay away from the phone and it fades; standing on grass in daylight speeds that up, and Addictol wipes it. A heavy habit gives phantom notifications when you put the phone down, and from 60% real withdrawal: mining fatigue, then weakness and slowness. Opening the phone calms it for a moment.
questbook.skofcraft.phone.title: Phone
questbook.skofcraft.phone.p1: Craft a Phone from 4 Iron Nuggets, a Glass Pane, 2 Copper Ingots and Redstone.
questbook.skofcraft.phone.p2: Right-click to open the phone. Scrollr is an endless feed to doomscroll: scroll with the mouse wheel or drag, and click a heart to like a post. Amazooon sells finished nicotine products for diamonds: press Buy and a carrier plane drops the package on your head. The game keeps running, so watch your back. Flappy Block is a tap-to-flap game: click or press Space to fly through the pipes. Lucky Creeper is a casino with three tables: a slot machine, blackjack and roulette. Bets are real diamonds and the server does all the rolling, so there is no cheating. Three of a kind pays up to 25 times your bet, but the house has the edge.
questbook.skofcraft.phone.p3: The battery drains while you use it and recharges while the phone is closed.
questbook.skofcraft.heading: SKOFCRAFT Guide
questbook.skofcraft.intro.title: Getting Started
questbook.skofcraft.intro.p1: Welcome! This book explains how to make everything in SKOFCRAFT. Pick a chapter on the left and scroll with the mouse wheel.
questbook.skofcraft.intro.p2: Snus route: Seeds > Fresh Leaf > Dried Leaf > Ground Tobacco > Snus Pouch > Snus Box.
questbook.skofcraft.intro.p3: Nicotine route: Dried Leaf > Nicotine Extract > Nicotine Pouch (with a flavor) > Pouch Box.
questbook.skofcraft.intro.p4: Manual machines are cranked by hand (Shift + right-click). FE machines run on Forge Energy instead.
questbook.skofcraft.farming.title: Tobacco Farming
questbook.skofcraft.farming.p1: Craft Tobacco Seeds from any Oak Leaves, or buy them from a Tobacconist villager.
questbook.skofcraft.farming.p2: Plant the seeds on farmland and wait until the plant is fully grown (8 stages).
questbook.skofcraft.farming.p3: Break a fully grown plant to get Fresh Tobacco Leaves. Breaking it early only gives the seed back.
questbook.skofcraft.farming.p4: Tobacconists also buy Fresh Tobacco Leaves for emeralds.
questbook.skofcraft.drying.title: Drying Leaves
questbook.skofcraft.drying.p1: The Manual Dryer turns Fresh Tobacco Leaves into Dried Tobacco Leaves.
questbook.skofcraft.drying.p2: Right-click the machine to open it and put leaves in the left slot. Then Shift + right-click it to crank: each crank adds 1 second of work and a leaf needs 10 seconds. Take the result from the right slot.
questbook.skofcraft.grinding.title: Grinding
questbook.skofcraft.grinding.p1: The Manual Grinder crushes Dried Tobacco Leaves into Ground Tobacco.
questbook.skofcraft.grinding.p2: One leaf gives 2 Ground Tobacco. Crank it like the dryer; a leaf needs about 8 cranks.
questbook.skofcraft.snus.title: Snus Pouches
questbook.skofcraft.snus.p1: The Manual Pouch Press packs Ground Tobacco into Empty Pouches. Empty Pouches cannot be crafted: buy them from a Tobacconist villager.
questbook.skofcraft.snus.p2: Put Ground Tobacco in the middle slot and an Empty Pouch in the right one, then crank. You get a Snus Pouch. The left slot is an optional booster: Nicotine Extract makes Strong snus, 1 Nicotine Crystal Extra Strong, and 2 Crystals Premium.
questbook.skofcraft.nicotine.title: Nicotine Pouches
questbook.skofcraft.nicotine.p1: A nicotine pouch takes 3 steps: the Mixer combines Neutral Base, Nicotine and a Flavor into a Nicotine Mix, then the Press turns the Mix and an Empty Pouch into a Nicotine Pouch.
questbook.skofcraft.nicotine.p2: Plant Fiber: 3 Sugar Cane make 2 fibers. Neutral Base: 4 fibers and a Water Bucket make 4 bases (you keep the bucket).
questbook.skofcraft.nicotine.p3: Nicotine Extract comes from the FE Nicotine Extractor. It needs power, so build an FE Dryer first (see Powered Machines). Smelt an Extract in a furnace to get a stronger Nicotine Crystal.
questbook.skofcraft.nicotine.p4: Mixer slots: Neutral Base, Nicotine, Flavor. Extract gives a normal pouch, 1 Crystal Strong, 2 Crystals Extra Strong. The flavor changes the bonus (Mint gives extra speed). Mint Flavor can be bought from a Tobacconist; other flavors have no survival recipe yet.
questbook.skofcraft.snuff.title: Snuff
questbook.skofcraft.snuff.p1: Snuff is finely ground tobacco you sniff through the nose. Mix Ground Tobacco with any Flavor in a Mixer: Ground Tobacco in the left slot, the Flavor in the right slot, middle slot empty.
questbook.skofcraft.snuff.p2: Hold right-click to raise the tin to your nose and sniff. You get a strong burst of Speed and Haste for 30 seconds plus the flavor's effect, with a moment of nausea.
questbook.skofcraft.snuff.p3: Each pinch counts as a strong product for tolerance and addiction, and there is a short cooldown between pinches.
questbook.skofcraft.vape.title: Vapes
questbook.skofcraft.vape.p1: A vape is a reusable device with a limited number of puffs (30 by default). Craft an Empty Vape from an iron nugget, a glass pane and a copper ingot, top to bottom.
questbook.skofcraft.vape.p2: Fill it in a Mixer: Empty Vape in the left slot, a Nicotine Mix in the middle slot, flavor slot empty. The flavor and strength of the mix carry over.
questbook.skofcraft.vape.p3: Hold right-click to take a puff: a short Speed and Haste boost plus the flavor's effect. The bar shows the puffs left, and you get an Empty Vape back to refill when it runs out. Each puff builds a little tolerance and addiction.
questbook.skofcraft.cigarette.title: Cigarettes
questbook.skofcraft.cigarette.p1: Craft Cigarettes from Plant Fiber (the filter), Ground Tobacco and Paper, top to bottom. You get 2.
questbook.skofcraft.cigarette.p2: Hold right-click to light and smoke one. You get a long, mild Speed and Haste boost (60 seconds), but cigarettes are very addictive, and with negative effects on they leave you weakened for a few seconds.
questbook.skofcraft.cigarette.p3: Craft an Empty Cigarette Pack from 4 Paper, then let the FE Packager fill it with a full set of Cigarettes (20 by default).
questbook.skofcraft.cigarette.p4: Right-click a full pack to take out one cigarette at a time.
questbook.skofcraft.chew.title: Chewing Tobacco
questbook.skofcraft.chew.p1: Craft Chewing Tobacco from 3 Dried Tobacco Leaves and a Sugar. You get 2 plugs.
questbook.skofcraft.chew.p2: It works like a pouch: right-click to tuck one into a gum slot, where it lasts 30 minutes by default. On top of the usual Speed and Haste it gives Resistance and Night Vision.
questbook.skofcraft.chew.p3: While you chew you must spit at least once every 5 minutes (press V by default), or you get nausea and slowness until you do. There is a 30 second cooldown between spits.
questbook.skofcraft.chew.p4: Spit on a creature to blind it for 3 seconds: a player sees a brown splash over the screen and mobs lose their target. Spit at the ground to leave a Spit Puddle that slows whatever walks through it and slowly dries up.
questbook.skofcraft.chicha.title: Chicha
questbook.skofcraft.chicha.p1: Craft a Chicha from 4 String (the hoses), a Bowl, a Glass Bottle and 3 Iron Ingots.
questbook.skofcraft.chicha.p2: Right-click it with Ground Tobacco to load it (8 puffs each, 40 at most) and with a Flavor to set its flavor. Sneak and right-click with an empty hand to see what is inside.
questbook.skofcraft.chicha.p3: Right-click with an empty hand to take one of its 4 hoses, so up to 4 players can share a chicha. Hold right-click with the hose to puff: Speed and Haste for 30 seconds plus the flavor's effect. Each puff uses one load.
questbook.skofcraft.chicha.p4: Stay within 4 blocks of the chicha or the hose slips away and goes back. Sneak and right-click the chicha to put your hose back yourself.
questbook.skofcraft.cigar.title: Cigars
questbook.skofcraft.cigar.p1: Cigarillos and Cigars are smoked like cigarettes, but last longer and hit harder. A Cigarillo is two Dried Tobacco Leaves wrapped around Ground Tobacco: you get 2.
questbook.skofcraft.cigar.p2: A Cigar takes 3 Dried Tobacco Leaves, 3 Ground Tobacco and a Gold Nugget for the band.
questbook.skofcraft.cigar.p3: Hold right-click to smoke. Cigarillo: 3.6 second smoke for a 2 minute Speed and Haste boost. Cigar: 6 second smoke for a 3 minute boost at level II, plus Resistance. Both are very addictive and weaken you for a while when negative effects are on.
questbook.skofcraft.addictol.title: Addictol
questbook.skofcraft.addictol.p1: Addictol resets your tolerance and addiction back to 0, and clears withdrawal weakness, mining fatigue and nausea.
questbook.skofcraft.addictol.p2: Craft it from 4 Golden Apples in the corners and a Milk Bucket in the middle (you keep the bucket). Hold right-click to take it.
questbook.skofcraft.tobacconist.title: Tobacconist
questbook.skofcraft.tobacconist.p1: Place a Tobacconist Counter next to a villager without a job and they become a Tobacconist. Some plains villages already have a tobacco house, where the Manual Mixer also works as a counter.
questbook.skofcraft.tobacconist.p2: He sells seeds, flavors, empty pouches, boxes and packs, and finished products: snus, nicotine pouches, cigarettes, cigarillos, cigars, snuff, chewing tobacco, vapes, a Chicha and even Addictol. He also sells the Quest Book for a Book and 2 emeralds.
questbook.skofcraft.tobacconist.p3: He buys fresh and dried leaves, Plant Fiber, Ground Tobacco, Nicotine Extract, filled snus, pouch and cigarette boxes, and strong or premium snus pouches.
questbook.skofcraft.tobacconist.p4: Keep trading to level him up: new offers unlock at each of the 5 levels. Wandering traders also carry tobacco seeds. The villager can be turned off in the config.
questbook.skofcraft.packaging.title: Boxes
questbook.skofcraft.packaging.p1: Craft empty boxes first: wood for snus, paper for nicotine pouches.
questbook.skofcraft.packaging.p2: The FE Packager fills a box with a full set of pouches of the same type (20 by default). Snus Pouches go in Snus Boxes, Nicotine Pouches in Pouch Boxes. Flavor and strength are kept. Pouches do not stack, so the Packager's pouch slot works as a counter: add them one at a time (it shows 5/20) and it packs a box once full. The Press output counts the same way: click it to take pouches one by one, Shift-click to take them all.
questbook.skofcraft.packaging.p3: Right-click a filled box to take out one pouch at a time. It becomes an empty box when it runs out.
questbook.skofcraft.power.title: Powered Machines
questbook.skofcraft.power.p1: Each FE machine is an upgrade of a manual one: put the manual machine in the middle of the recipe.
questbook.skofcraft.power.p2: FE machines work on their own, no cranking. Each stores 10,000 FE and accepts up to 500 FE/t. Use per tick: Dryer 20, Grinder 40, Mixer 60, Press 60, Packager 80, Extractor 100, industrial machines 200. Hover the orange bar to see the charge. The Packager always needs power.
questbook.skofcraft.industrial.title: Industrial Machines
questbook.skofcraft.industrial.p1: Industrial machines are upgrades of FE machines that work faster.
questbook.skofcraft.industrial.p2: The Snus Line works like a Mixer (6 s instead of 10 s) and the Pouch Line like a Press (4.5 s instead of 7.5 s). The Extractor takes 6 s instead of 9 s and the Packager 4 s instead of 8 s.
questbook.skofcraft.using.title: Using Pouches
questbook.skofcraft.using.p1: Right-click a pouch to place it in one of your 4 gum slots. It lasts several minutes (15 by default).
questbook.skofcraft.using.p2: Press G (default key) to open the gum screen, see the time left and right-click a slot to discard its pouch.
questbook.skofcraft.using.p3: Active pouches give Speed and Haste, stronger with 2 or more. Strong pouches add +1 and Extra Strong or Premium +2, but build tolerance and addiction faster. Nicotine Pouches add a bonus depending on their flavor.
questbook.skofcraft.using.p4: Careful: 3 pouches at once cause nausea and 4 slow you down (Premium pouches avoid this). Heavy use builds tolerance, and stopping once your addiction is above 70% brings withdrawal (weakness, mining fatigue). These can be disabled in the config.

questbook.skofcraft.skofee.title: SKOFee
questbook.skofcraft.skofee.p1: SKOFee is the mod's coffee. Craft 2 SKOFee Seeds from Cocoa Beans and Wheat Seeds, or buy them from a Tobacconist or a Wandering Trader.
questbook.skofcraft.skofee.p2: Plant them on farmland. The bush grows green cherries, then red ones once ripe (8 stages). Break it when red to get 2 to 4 SKOFee Cherries. Dry the cherries in a Dryer to get Green SKOFee Beans.
questbook.skofcraft.skofee.p3: Roast the green beans in a Furnace, Smoker or Campfire, then put the Roasted Beans in a Grinder for 2 Ground SKOFee each.
questbook.skofcraft.skofee.p4: Craft 4 Empty SKOFee Cups from Bricks, and the SKOFee Machine from Iron, a Bucket, Glass Panes and a Furnace.
questbook.skofcraft.skofee.p5: Right-click the machine with a Water Bucket (8 cups, 16 at most) and with Ground SKOFee (one per click, sneak to put in the whole stack, 32 at most). Right-click it with an Empty Cup to brew: stop the needle in the green to tamp and heat, then stop the pour at the line. The better you do, the better the cup: Burnt, Decent, Good or Perfect (longer effects, and Speed II for Perfect). Press Escape to cancel without using anything. Empty hand shows what is inside.
questbook.skofcraft.skofee.p6: A Cup of SKOFee gives Speed and Haste for 3 minutes and gives the cup back. Mix it with a Milk Bucket for a SKOFee Latte: a bit shorter but it also fills you up. Ground SKOFee and Sugar also make the Coffee Flavor.
questbook.skofcraft.skofee.p7: Careful: from the third cup within 5 minutes you get the jitters (Nausea and Hunger), and every extra cup makes it worse.
advancements.skofcraft.first_skofee.desc: Drink a Cup of SKOFee or a SKOFee Latte.
